# Plumber King Agency

> Plumber King Agency builds fast, conversion-focused websites, local SEO and AI-search visibility for plumbing companies in the USA and Canada, so homeowners find you, trust you and call you.

Plumber King Agency is owned by Bennett & Co LLC. It works only with plumbing companies, in the USA and Canada. Contact: nick@plumberkingagency.com. Founder: Nick.

## Services

- [Plumber Website Design](https://plumberkingagency.com/services/plumber-website-design/): Custom plumber websites built to convert: click-to-call on every screen, service and city pages, fast load times and SEO built in. USA and Canada.
- [Plumber SEO & AI Search](https://plumberkingagency.com/services/plumber-seo/): Local SEO for plumbers: Google Business Profile, service and city pages, reviews, technical SEO and AI-search (GEO/AEO) so assistants like ChatGPT recommend you.
- [Lead Capture & Follow-up](https://plumberkingagency.com/services/plumber-lead-generation/): Lead capture and follow-up for plumbing companies: quote forms, instant lead alerts to your phone, and conversion testing so more visitors become booked jobs.

## FAQ

### How much does a plumber website cost?

It depends on how many services and service areas you need and whether you want SEO and lead follow-up on top. We quote after a free strategy call, once we know what you actually need, so you are not paying for pages that will never bring in a job.

### How long does it take to build a plumber website?

Usually 1 to 2 weeks from start to launch, sometimes less. Waiting on logins or content is what slows it down.

### Do I own my website?

Yes. Once the project is paid in full, you own the final website and content we created for you.

### Do you only work with plumbers?

Yes. Plumber King Agency works with plumbing companies. That focus means we already know which jobs are worth targeting, what homeowners search for and what makes them trust a plumber enough to call.

### Do you work with plumbers outside the USA?

We work with plumbing companies across the USA and Canada.

### What if I already have a website?

We start with a free website audit to see what is working and what is not. Sometimes a redesign is the right move, often we can improve what you have. You get an honest recommendation for your situation.

### How long until I see results from SEO?

SEO builds over months, not days, and it depends on your city and how strong your competitors are. A well-built site with click-to-call and a properly set up Google Business Profile can start helping you convert visitors from launch day. We will never promise you a top ranking by a set date, because nobody honest can.

### Will my business show up in ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews?

Nobody controls what AI assistants say. What we can do is make your business easy for them to understand and trust: clear answers to common plumbing questions on your site, consistent name, address and phone details across the web, reviews, and structured data that describes your services and service area. That is what AI search tools rely on.

### Do I have to sign a long-term contract?

No. By default the contract runs for your project and ends once the site is launched and optimized. If you want ongoing SEO, maintenance and upgrades, we can agree a longer plan that fits you.

### What happens after launch?

Every website comes with 3 months of support after launch, written into the contract: if something breaks, we fix it. After that, support is paid. We also offer yearly hosting and maintenance, and a hosting and security package for clients who want everything handled.

### How do you measure success?

We track what matters: phone calls, form submissions and real leads, plus your traffic and search rankings, in reports written in plain English. Real results, not vanity metrics.

### Who is a good fit for Plumber King Agency?

Plumbing companies in the USA and Canada that are serious about growing and know which jobs they want more of. If our first call shows we are not the right fit, we tell you straight instead of taking a project that would waste your time and money.

### What happens on the free strategy call?

It is a free 30-minute call. We look at your website, your Google presence and your competitors, and tell you straight what would get you more calls. If we are a good fit, you get a proposal with the scope, price and timeline.

### What do you need from me?

Your logins (domain, Google Business Profile and hosting, if you have them), a few real photos, and quick feedback on drafts. Waiting on logins or content is the main thing that slows a project down.

### Do I need to write the content?

No. We gather what we need on the strategy call and write the copy for you, focused on the jobs you actually want. You review and approve it before anything goes live.

### Do you offer hosting and maintenance?

Yes. Every website comes with 3 months of support after launch. After that you can choose yearly hosting and maintenance, and a hosting and security package is available for clients who want everything handled.
